{
  "project_id": "P-ALB-CitizenServiceDelivery",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "ADISA's lack of operational history and implementation experience may lead to execution delays and operational management inefficiencies.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire experienced PMU staff, provide continuous technical assistance, and establish structured operational procedures under MIPA supervision.",
      "evidence": "ADISA has a limited track record of implementation experience, but some members of the project team have relevant experience."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "High procurement risk at ADISA and PMU could result in procurement delays for critical technical assistance and ICT contracts.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Use CFCU for initial PPF procurement, hire dedicated procurement specialists, and require World Bank prior review for key contracts.",
      "evidence": "Since ADISA is a newly-created agency and the PMU is not yet fully set up, the procurement risk rating is high."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Substantial financial management risk due to lack of prior experience with Bank-funded operations at MIPA and ADISA.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire qualified financial specialists, establish a Financial Management Manual, purchase accounting software, and conduct annual audits.",
      "evidence": "Neither MIPA, nor the recently constituted ADISA have previous experience in implementation of large donor funded operations"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Physical construction of the Citizen Service Center building may cause localized environmental impacts including dust, noise, and waste.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce compliance with a project-specific Environmental Management Plan (EMP) integrated into civil works construction contracts.",
      "evidence": "Potential environmental impacts that are associated with new construction include dust and noise, waste generation, material supply, use of machinery"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Focusing on digital services and urban CSCs risks excluding rural, poor, elderly, and minority citizens with low digital literacy.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish assisted digital outreach points, maintain existing local access points, conduct targeted non-digital communication, and monitor vulnerable user access.",
      "evidence": "There is a risk that the focus on state-of-the-art means for service delivery... will diminish access of the poor and vulnerable"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Complex coordination requirements across more than a dozen agencies could impede business process re-engineering and system integration.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Leverage Inter-Ministerial Committees and the Prime Minister's Delivery Unit to enforce agency cooperation and track reform milestones.",
      "evidence": "Inter-sectoral reforms, especially those that involve more than a dozen government agencies, necessarily entail complex coordination."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Compressed reform timeline and ambitious targets for legal amendments and service re-engineering may lead to schedule slippage.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize a phased approach, focus early on quick wins, and link financial disbursements to DLIs spread through 2020.",
      "evidence": "The compressed implementation timeline is a potential risk, which is mitigated by the project's span and incentives to deliver up to 2020."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Resistance from agency officials and civil servants reluctant to yield front-office authority could delay front-office integration.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement change management programs, conduct internal stakeholder outreach, and secure top-level political mandate via the Prime Minister.",
      "evidence": "Ministries, agencies and individual civil servants may not welcome ceding the front office function to CSC. Bureaucratic resistance could stifle efforts"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Incomplete database digitization and missing personal ID numbers in agency registers hinder database interoperability and service automation.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide TA for database cleanup, standardize data formats, and connect agency databases to the Government Interoperability Platform.",
      "evidence": "Property and pension records, for example, are only partially digitized... The National ID number is missing for most records"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Inaccuracies in administrative tracking data may mask actual processing delays experienced by citizens.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy independent third-party verification, periodic citizen surveys, and proactive text-message beneficiary feedback collection.",
      "evidence": "The data submitted by the IPRO office on the other hand routinely records that almost all applications are processed within the required six days."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Delays in achieving Disbursement Linked Indicators or meeting condition DLI#5 could freeze results-based loan disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize completion of institutional prerequisites, perform regular DLI tracking, and engage third-party verification early.",
      "evidence": "No disbursements under RBF will be made until DLI#5 is achieved... disbursements under RBF are contingent upon achieving DLIs."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Inadequate long-term budget provision for software licensing, maintenance, and periodic upgrades could jeopardize e-service operations.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Factor ongoing ICT licenses and maintenance costs into long-term fiscal planning using budget savings realized through administrative re-engineering.",
      "evidence": "Ongoing operating costs are expected to include licenses and system operation and maintenance... cost of such upgrades should also be appropriately factored"
    }
  ]
}
